title: 引擎汽缸頭冷卻設計
summary: 從鑄造水道到熱流與局部溫度，檢查幾何堵塞、氣穴與熱疲勞。
summaryEn: Follow cast passages through heat flow and local temperature, checking geometric blockage, vapor pockets and thermal fatigue.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 冷卻表面對流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Surface convection: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 冷卻表面對流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Surface convection and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為汽缸頭水套、橋區與熱點。對流係數是情境假設，依流態和幾何而變；無法從此直接判定沸騰裕度。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows cylinder-head jackets, bridge regions and hot spots. The assumed convection coefficient varies with geometry and flow and does not establish boiling margin.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：Qdot=h A DeltaT；h=1500 W/(m²K)、A=.08 m²、DeltaT=30 K；計算結果=3600 W。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: Qdot=h A DeltaT; h=1500 W/(m²K), A=.08 m², DeltaT=30 K; result=3600 W.
steps.failure: 局部氣穴或堵塞可能造成溫度升高；需多點溫度與壓差，不只總流量。
steps.failureEn: Local vapor pockets or blockage can raise temperature; use multiple temperatures and pressure drop, not total flow alone.
steps.check: 基準3600 W；更換h時須交代測試或關聯式來源。 將此判讀連回汽缸頭水套、橋區與熱點的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Baseline is 3600 W; a different h needs a stated test or correlation. Relate this interpretation to cylinder-head jackets, bridge regions and hot spots and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
